extracted.name: Hearty Kale Soup (low sodium)
extracted.description: You can add wide egg noodles if you want, pretty good on my first try. Pairs great with crackers and a glass of ice water. Check out my recipe!
ingredient_lines: 1 tbs Chicken bouillon or 1c chicken broth
instruction_lines: Boil pinto beans until tender then drain and rinse
Heat frying oil in a pot. Add diced onions, minced garlic, garlic paste & sauté for 10 minutes on medium-low heat
Add tomato paste, thyme, cayenne pepper, paprika, chili & cumin powder. Simmer until the paste cooks to a dark red color. Add water if needed

Add raw chicken thighs and sauté. After about 10 minutes add 4c water or 2c water, 2c broth and bring to a boil. I added pinto beans, chicken bouillon, adobo seasoning and black pepper into the water broth at this point.
Lower heat, cover and simmer on medium-low for 1hr. Shred cooked chicken, then add vinegar, carrots, and chopped kale. simmer for about another 30min-1hr until carrots are tender.
